* Every child is drawn through protocol's render, so one handed no column draws nothing, as under Rich's Console.render (rich-unfiled-791c.wyrk)

render(renderable, options) in src/core/protocol.ts is the one place the
under-one-column rule is kept; every src/ call of a Renderable's render goes
through it, and test/seam/render-calls.test.ts fails on one that does not.
The drawsNothing checks in Padding, Panel, Table, Traceback and Markdown are
gone. Tree no longer holds a row for a label that drew nothing, as Rich's
does not. squeezed-child.golden.json pins Rich 15's rows for Padding, Panel,
Constrain, Tree, Layout and Markdown at a width that leaves the child none.

* render is exported and the protocol page draws children through it; the render-calls gate sees an optional-chained receiver (rich-unfiled-791c.wyrk review)
